statement: One versioned comparative evidence contract extends the terminal scale-evidence identity with immutable pair, alternative, parity, statistics, price, artifact, and claim fields, and its deterministic guard accepts positive, neutral, and negative complete fixtures while rejecting incomplete or incomparable evidence.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until scale-certification-evidence-contract is terminal; all comparative records must reference that shared profile identity.
Schema validity and Quest closure must not depend on the sign or desirability of a comparative result.
